specGapResolved: PLAN GAP: §2.10 FINDINGS carries id/severity/lens/claim/evidence/suggestedFix and NO item reference, yet §3.2 requires 'every item its blocksItems names' to be blocked at the round cap. The plan never says how a plan-level finding maps to items. PINNED DECISION (no schema widening): the handler derives blocksItems by scanning the finding's claim+evidence for (a) known queue item ids and (b) file paths that intersect an item's fileScope via core scopesIntersect. A finding that names neither still becomes a question record with blocksItems:[] and blocks nothing — the run then proceeds on all items, which is consistent with §3.2's 'the run proceeds on the remaining items'. This gap and its resolution MUST be raised at the Phase 9 milestone gate and logged in CORRECTIONS.md.

assertions.text: conductor_plan_review fans out exactly the §3.2 FOUR lenses as fresh sub-sessions in role 'reviewer' — (a) correctness/design soundness, (b) completeness vs the user's prompt (placeholder scan folded in), (c) decomposition quality (item size, scope disjointness, DAG honesty), (d) minimality/ponytail — each carrying ONE lens-specific prompt, asserted on the fake's recorded prompts: the four prompts are pairwise DIFFERENT and each names its own lens, and every dispatch sees the plan AND the queue

every finding of severity 'major' gets exactly config.workflow.skepticsPerFinding skeptic sub-sessions dispatched (schema Verdict), and minors/nits get NONE — asserted by counting the fake's dispatches per finding id
a major whose skeptics refute it (upholds below the findingSurvives ceil(k/2) threshold) does NOT survive: it triggers no planner re-prompt and, at the cap, produces no question and blocks nothing

a SURVIVING major causes the planner to be re-prompted with the findings (the re-prompt text names the surviving claim), the plan is revised and re-written, and run.planReviewRounds increments by exactly one per round
a review round yielding zero surviving majors exits the loop and advances the run to PLAN_REVIEWED, journaling the transition through the existing fsm/transition event

when planReviewMaxRounds is reached with majors still surviving, EACH surviving major is written to questions.jsonl as a §2.11 record with origin exactly 'plan-review-cap', a non-empty question text carrying the claim, and a schema-valid QuestionRecord shape

every item named by a cap-question's blocksItems is set blocked:{questionId, reason, stage:'plan-review'} — asserted by READING THE PERSISTED ITEM FILES via store.loadItem, never by inspecting a journal/log line (the plan calls this out explicitly)

items NOT named by any surviving major are left unblocked and the run still advances (the run proceeds on the remaining items rather than halting) — a partially-blocked queue is a legal, asserted outcome
